llm.summary: This skill contains no executable code or data access, but it tries to make itself an always-on identity layer that overrides normal agent behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill is Markdown-only, declares no required binaries, and I found no network calls, credential handling, command execution, or local data indexing instructions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: README.md describes manual local installation and browser upload, including setting it as always active or an identity skill; no package scripts, binaries, or automatic installer were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md declares the skill affects every thought, response, and action, says to use it always, and states that its directive overrides all default behavior; this is broader than a normal task-scoped skill.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifacts repeatedly frame the skill as permanent identity-level behavior rather than optional guidance, creating persistent influence over unrelated tasks without clear boundaries or user controls.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is a cognitive-style/meta-reasoning skill, and the artifacts mostly contain reasoning, communication, creativity, and self-review guidance.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this carefully before installing as an always-active or identity skill. It does not appear to run code or access private data, but it can broadly reshape agent behavior across all tasks; install only if you want that persistent style and are comfortable relying on platform priority rules to keep system and safety instructions above it.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The Indonesian README and always-active framing match the author's disclosed meta-skill concept, but the README language itself does not create runtime data or execution risk; the always-active scope remains a user-control concern.
[SQP-1] expected: The universal scope is explicit and purpose-aligned for an identity-style skill, but it is materially overbroad because it is not limited by task type or user opt-in at runtime.
[SQP-3] unexpected: The claim that the directive overrides all default behavior is not necessary for a reasoning-quality skill and creates prompt-priority ambiguity.
[SSD-1] unexpected: The override and foundational-identity language is artifact-backed and raises concern even though there is no executable payload.
[SSD-1] expected: The cognitive-partner persona is consistent with the skill's stated purpose, but it contributes to the broader persistence concern when combined with permanent and always-on wording.
